notes.title: Hitbox Is Now Free!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's been a busy few months, and we know we have been pretty under the radar. Both developers have been busy with new full time jobs and school.

The point of selling this game on Steam was never to make money off players, we just wanted to make a fun game that people could enjoy. For that reason, Hitbox is now free to play forever. There is no limited in game purchases required, there are no catches, just enjoy the game we spent countless hours on.

If you purchased the game when we released it, thank you so much for supporting us, you allowed us to put food on the table and support ourselves while we worked on this passion project, and thanks to you, we now have a fantastic game to show for it.

We are currently talking about future projects, and how we can learn and grow as game developers, so if you have anything you'd like to tell us, please don't hesitate to share.

Thank you again for everything,

[b]David and Tyler[/b]
Hitbox Developers
